_what: The provenance record for every third-party asset the arena's Tier 2 figure library is built from (report 13 §9.1, §9.2). tools/build-figures.mjs reads it, builds web/public/models/figures.glb from the sources named here, and WRITES web/src/arena/figures/models.json from what it measured — so the manifest is the hand-written half (where a file came from, what its licence badge said on the day) and models.json is the measured half (heights, bones, triangles, the clip names that really exist).
_licence_rule: Only CC0 assets are used at all. The badge text below is what the download page said ON THE DAY, verbatim, because that is the only evidence that survives the page changing — Quaternius relicensed one of its 83 packs sixteen days before this was written (report 12 §0.2), and QAL §7 says the version in force when you obtained the asset governs.
_never: Nothing derived from card art may ever appear here. Marvel art is licensed to Wizards; the Fan Content Policy's line is "If you don't have the rights to use another person's stuff in your Fan Content—don't" (https://company.wizards.com/en/legal/fancontentpolicy). NOTICE §2 and the Scryfall images already live under that rule.
_where: The downloaded archives are NOT committed. They live under var/assets/figures/ (var/ is gitignored) and `tools/build-figures.mjs --src` points at them. Re-download with the URLs and sha256s below.
